interface_coverage.scope: Coordinate count bound for exact interior elimination when all four registered material walls remain independent. This is neither a runtime bound nor a restriction on embedded wall quadrature.

measured_embedding.scope: Authoring-side displacement-fit diagnostic on one accepted full-order frame; source-body ancestry, regional ownership and all retained material boundaries use the registered scene. Material inverse mass and dynamic tangent are not substituted by this test. No sustained or reduced native throughput is measured.

refined.control_order: Referenced source-parent nodes in ascending order, followed by retained current fine nodes in ascending order.
refined.scope: Same-frame adaptive fit. Its displacement and strain checks are in-sample. No nonlinear, force-response or sustained timing qualification.

held_out.scope: Unseen half-interval full-order mechanical release. Fixed-basis projection is a kinematic comparison. Forces, accepted dynamic advancement of the reduced space, and sustained speed require their own tests.

scope: Reduced coordinate construction and native full-order reference. This basis has no qualified reduced native advance. The detailed mesh remains the physical reference.
